Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to synthesize the available information from the initial search results to form a definitive answer. After the WebSurfer returned search results clearly indicating the holding (male-only draft registration), the Planner did not conclude the task. Instead, it immediately issued redundant instructions to the WebSurfer to retrieve the same information again, creating an inefficient loop. This mirrors the error pattern in Example 2 (Case #333), where the Planner failed to consolidate information already available and repeatedly redirected tasks to other agents despite having sufficient data to answer the question.
